+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+SENDGRID_BATCH_CREATE_URL = "https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/batch"
+SENDGRID_MAIL_SEND_URL = "https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send"
+
+
+def _sendgrid_headers(api_key: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    return {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+
+
+def create_sendgrid_batch_id(api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    api_key = api_key or os.environ["SENDGRID_API_KEY"]
+    response = requests.post(
+        SENDGRID_BATCH_CREATE_URL,
+        headers=_sendgrid_headers(api_key),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    batch_id = data.get("batch_id")
+    if not batch_id:
+        raise RuntimeError("SendGrid did not return a batch_id")
+    return batch_id
+
+
+def build_sendgrid_message(
+    to_email: str,
+    subject: str,
+    content: str,
+    batch_id: str,
+    custom_args: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    message: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "personalizations": [
+            {
+                "to": [{"email": to_email}],
+                "subject": subject,
+                "custom_args": custom_args or {},
+            }
+        ],
+        "from": {"email": os.environ.get("SENDGRID_FROM_EMAIL", "noreply@example.com")},
+        "content": [{"type": "text/plain", "value": content}],
+        "batch_id": batch_id,
+    }
+    return message
+
+
+def publish_batch_messages(
+    messages: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]], api_key: Optional[str] = None
+) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_key = api_key or os.environ["SENDGRID_API_KEY"]
+    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for message in messages:
+        response = requests.post(
+            SENDGRID_MAIL_SEND_URL,
+            headers=_sendgrid_headers(api_key),
+            data=json.dumps(message),
+            timeout=30,
+        )
+        results.append(
+            {
+                "status_code": response.status_code,
+                "ok": response.ok,
+                "response_text": response.text,
+            }
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+    return results
+
+
+def publish_batch_with_ids(
+    recipients: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]],
+    subject: str,
+    content: str,
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    batch_id = create_sendgrid_batch_id(api_key=api_key)
+    messages = []
+    for recipient in recipients:
+        email = recipient["email"]
+        attrs = {k: v for k, v in recipient.items() if k != "email"}
+        messages.append(build_sendgrid_message(email, subject, content, batch_id, attrs))
+    publish_results = publish_batch_messages(messages, api_key=api_key)
+    return {"batch_id": batch_id, "results": publish_results}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sample_recipients = [
+        {"email": "alice@example.com", "id": "user-1", "segment": "alpha"},
+        {"email": "bob@example.com", "id": "user-2", "segment": "beta"},
+    ]
+    output = publish_batch_with_ids(
+        sample_recipients,
+        subject="Batch publish example",
+        content="This is a batched message.",
+    )
+    print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
+
+
+class DeadLetterPublisher:
+    def __init__(self, project_id: Optional[str] = None, topic_id: Optional[str] = None):
+        self.project_id = project_id or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
+        self.topic_id = topic_id or os.environ.get("DEAD_LETTER_TOPIC")
+        if not self.project_id:
+            raise ValueError("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT is required")
+        if not self.topic_id:
+            raise ValueError("DEAD_LETTER_TOPIC is required")
+        self.publisher = pubsub_v1.PublisherClient()
+        self.topic_path = self.publisher.topic_path(self.project_id, self.topic_id)
+
+    def send_failed_message(self, message: Dict[str, Any], error: str, original_topic: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+        payload = {
+            "message": message,
+            "error": error,
+            "original_topic": original_topic,
+        }
+        data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
+        future = self.publisher.publish(self.topic_path, data=data, content_type="application/json")
+        return future.result()
+
+
+def send_failed_message(message: Dict[str, Any], error: str, original_topic: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    return DeadLetterPublisher().send_failed_message(message, error, original_topic)
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from google.cloud import pubsub_v1
+
+
+def consume_event() -> str:
+    project_id = os.environ["GCP_PROJECT_ID"]
+    subscription_id = os.environ["GCP_PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION"]
+    subscription_path = f"projects/{project_id}/subscriptions/{subscription_id}"
+    subscriber = pubsub_v1.SubscriberClient()
+    response = subscriber.pull(subscription=subscription_path, max_messages=1, timeout=10)
+    if not response.received_messages:
+        return ""
+    received = response.received_messages[0]
+    ack_id = received.ack_id
+    message = received.message
+    payload = message.data.decode("utf-8") if message.data else ""
+    attributes = dict(message.attributes)
+    subscriber.acknowledge(subscription=subscription_path, ack_ids=[ack_id])
+    if attributes:
+        return json.dumps({"data": payload, "attributes": attributes}, ensure_ascii=False)
+    return payload
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(consume_event())
*** End Patch
